dedupe_keys.name: sdg e energy data by customer type

description: SDG&E: Energy Data By Customer Type is a dataset listed in Open Energy Hub (ORNL), an energy-sector data hub, published or maintained by Oak Ridge National Laboratory for the U.S. DOE Office of Electricity. The files below contain customer energy usage data by customer type (Residential, Commercial, Industrial and Agricultural) that has been aggregated by zip code. Coverage: the United States. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal files it under Electricity, Natural Gas. Its keywords are energy usage by customer type. The portal shows 2025-09-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is No license, or terms of use, asserted by data producer for this dataset was found.. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oeh-open-data-portal.
